title: Deal Pulse Series
description: A reference-driven Black Friday campaign system that locks urgency, bold hierarchy, and digital-retail energy across variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes an aggressive but controlled sale-world with dark backgrounds, electric highlights, abstract price-chip hierarchy, and premium product stacks; images 02-04 preserve that exact system while shifting category focus and retail surface.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-midnight-deal-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-electronics-drop-variation, 03-beauty-bundle-variation, 04-home-tech-cart-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-midnight-deal-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
